apiUrl.description: Base URL of the Atlas Backend API. Defaults to `https://api.atlasauth.net`, or the `ATLAS_API_URL` environment variable when set.

platformKey.description: Atlas platform key (`psk_...` or `atlas__psk_...`), needed only by platform resources such as `atlas.IdApp` (Sign in with Atlas apps). Prefer the `ATLAS_PLATFORM_KEY` environment variable.

secretKey.description: Atlas instance secret key (`sk_...` or `atlas_<env>_sk_...`). Prefer the `ATLAS_SECRET_KEY` environment variable so the key never lands in state or config.

baseUrl.description: — The old app's Better Auth base URL including its base path, e.g. `https://app.example.com/api/auth`; Atlas calls `<base_url>/get-session`. Must be a public https URL on a production instance.

enabled.description: — Turn the live check on. Requires `baseUrl`. Default `false`.

hasSecret.description: — Whether Atlas holds a secret for the old app (never the secret).

secretWo.description: **NOTE:** This field is write-only and its value will not be updated in state as part of read operations. — The old app's `BETTER_AUTH_SECRET` (at least 16 characters). Lets Atlas check the cookie signature and sign a bare token for the live call. Never stored in state or returned by Atlas. It is sent on create and whenever `secretWoVersion` changes; change the version to rotate it, or change the version with `secretWo` unset to clear it. Needs Terraform 1.11 or later.

secretWoVersion.description: — Any number; changing it sends `secretWo` again (or clears the secret when `secretWo` is unset).

attributes.description: — Extra HTML attributes your CMP's click handler listens for. Allowed names: `data-*`, `aria-*`, `id`, `class` and `href` (an https URL or a `#fragment`), lower case; at most 10, values up to 200 characters. `data-atlas-*` and event handlers (`on*`) are refused. Set a `preset`, `attributes`, or both.

label.description: — The link text, 1–60 characters, e.g. `Cookie settings`.

preset.description: — The CMP's reopen trigger: `cookiemunch` (adds `data-cc="show-settings"`), `cookiebot` (calls `Cookiebot.renew()`), `onetrust` (calls `OneTrust.ToggleInfoDisplay()`) or `custom` (adds nothing; use `attributes`).

renderedAttributes.description: — What Atlas renders on the link: `attributes` with the preset's trigger applied.

name.description: The preset's display name.

oauthClientId.description: The `clientId` of the service's first-party OAuth client, whose back-channel logout URI receives logout tokens when `backchannelLogoutUrl` is unset.

perCallAudience.description: Lets a token mint name its own audience per call (`getToken({ for, cbid })`, `?audience=`, or `?=`). A preset already allows its own parameter for the configured value only (chatly `channel`, forumulate and referalli `orgId`, cookiemunch `cbid`); set this block to allow more values, or to change them. Omit the block to keep the preset's default (a custom integration then mints its configured audience only); set `perCallAudienceDisabled = true` to turn it off.

perCallAudienceDisabled.description: Turn the per-call audience off, including a preset's default (sends `per_call_audience: null`). Cannot be combined with a `perCallAudience` block. Default `false`.

preset.description: The preset id, or null for a custom integration.

principalClaim.description: `audienceHint` (default) puts the principal claim on the token; `none` leaves it out.

ttlSeconds.description: Token lifetime, 10 to 120 seconds. Atlas's default (120) when unset.

verifyErrorReportUrl.description: An https URL the service reports token verification errors to (`POST /v1/integrations/verify_errors`).

atlas:index/getInstancePreflight:getInst.description: ## # atlas.getInstancePreflight (Data Source) Checks your instance setup in one call and lists everything Atlas can see is broken or worth knowing: social providers enabled without credentials, OAuth clients that cannot complete a sign-in, custom domains not serving yet, email sign-in with no email provider, and more. Each finding says what is wrong and how to fix it. Use it with a `check` block (a warning on every plan) or a `precondition` (fail the plan) to catch setup mistakes before they reach users. API: `GET /v1/instance/preflight`.

outputs.description: A collection of values returned by getInstancePreflight.

findings.description:
— Ordered error, then warning, then info. (see
below for nested schema)

id.description: — Always `preflight`.

ok.description: — True when there are no error-severity findings.
